column1: # CHAPTERS WITH BOLTED ASSEMBLIES THAT PREDATE THE JOINT-AUDIT RULE (11/08/2026)
# Check 9 demands that a chapter which BUILT a bolted assembly cite a JOINT AUDIT --
# app/vfy_joined.py -- which asks, from the MEMBER's side, what joins each part to anything.
# ⚡ WHY. E.4 was committed with a portal frame that reported `vfy_fit bolts=196 OK=196
# BOLT-NO-HOLE=0` and whose two rafters carried ZERO holes. Every bolt joined a plate to a column
# or a plate to a plate; the plates merely touched the rafter ends. vfy_fit verifies each BOLT
# against the parts it is LINKED to and is structurally blind to a member that was never in the
# joint. Amir opened the drawing and asked whether it was a sensible connection. It was not.
# These rows predate the rule. They are NOT declared correct -- they are declared UNAUDITED, out
# loud, on every run.
# ⚠️ THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. Adding a row to make the guard go green is the exact failure it
# exists to prevent.
# chapter
